bios.micro: Diego Dell'Agostino builds media products and the systems behind them. Posta, Roxom TV, and AI-assisted editorial operations.
bios.short: Diego Dell'Agostino has worked in digital media for more than 15 years. He co-founded Posta (ICFJ and SembraMedia’s Velocidad accelerator; PodX 2022) and joined Roxom TV’s founding team. He taught Digital Marketing at Digital House and served as a jury member for El Ojo de Iberoamérica (Audio & Sound). He now applies that experience to AI-native media.
bios.full: Diego Dell'Agostino has worked in digital media, product, and content strategy for more than 15 years. He co-founded Posta in Buenos Aires, where he worked across product, marketing, positioning, and business development. Posta took part in the Velocidad accelerator, run by ICFJ and SembraMedia; PodX acquired a majority stake in December 2022. He later joined Roxom TV’s founding team, working on media architecture and product operations for a 24/7 network spanning San Francisco, London, and Hong Kong, remotely from Buenos Aires. He was a Digital Marketing professor at Digital House (2017–2022) and Academic Content Lead for the initial and advanced courses in Argentina and Brazil (2018–2022), including immersion and in-company programs. He served on the jury of El Ojo de Iberoamérica in Audio & Sound Production (2021, 2023, and 2024). He also spoke as a panelist at the Ibero-American Colloquium on Digital Journalism at the University of Texas at Austin, in the framework of ICFJ. Today he builds and tests agents and infrastructure for media research, production, and distribution. He also writes Narrative Mechanics.
